title: Pieverse Went From 12 Cents to $2: Here's What It Actually Is
description: $PIEVERSE went from around 12 cents to over $2 in under a year, and the one number that matters most for this coin is the one I couldn't find published anywhere.

I break down what Pieverse actually is, the AI agent you rent inside Line or Kakao for $10 to $279 a month, the $7 million round led by Animoca Brands, the four wallets holding around 57% of the supply, the 12-month team and investor lock ending on November 14th, 2026, and the three numbers I'm watching.
